description: This Java class defines EntityWhereString, which encapsulates a raw SQL string condition used in database queries within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods to access and compare the raw SQL string, and implements the EntityCondition interface for use as a condition object in entity queries.

classes.name: EntityWhereString
classes.description: A class representing a raw SQL string condition used in entity query conditions. It allows embedding custom SQL snippets into where clauses, though it is flagged as unsafe and intended for minimal use.

methods.name: EntityWhereString
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the condition with a raw SQL string.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the stored SQL string is empty or null.

methods.name: makeWhereString
methods.description: Returns the raw SQL string to be used as a where clause snippet.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Performs validation on the model entity; here, it performs no operation.

methods.name: entityMatches
methods.description: Attempt to evaluate if an entity matches the condition; unsupported for raw SQL string conditions.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Attempt to evaluate if a map matches the condition; unsupported for raw SQL string conditions.

methods.name: getWhereString
methods.description: Returns the embedded raw SQL string.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Returns this object as an immutable condition.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for traversing or processing the condition.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality based on the stored SQL string.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on the SQL string.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation, which is the where string.
